title: Smart India Internal Hackathon 2026
summary: Get ready for the Smart India Internal Hackathon 2026 — an opportunity to innovate, collaborate, and build solutions for real-world challenges.
content:
Tech Tattva presents the Smart India Internal Hackathon 2026.

An exciting opportunity for students to come together, collaborate, think creatively, and develop innovative solutions to real-world problem statements.

Participants will get the chance to put their technical and problem-solving skills to the test while working as a team and transforming ideas into practical solutions.

Stay tuned for more details regarding the problem statements, registration, rules, and schedule.

Think. Build. Innovate. 🚀

title: CyberSecurity Workshop
summary: Learn practical cybersecurity through interactive sessions, real-world challenges, and hands-on CTF labs.
content:
Tech Tattva presents Cybersecurity Workshop 2026 — an interactive, hands-on session designed to introduce participants to practical cybersecurity concepts and real-world challenges.

Participants will explore key cybersecurity concepts, work through practical scenarios, and take on hands-on challenges through CTF-based labs. The workshop also provides insights into real-world applications of cybersecurity and the opportunities available in the field.

Whether you're just getting started or looking to strengthen your practical skills, this workshop is an opportunity to learn, experiment, and challenge yourself in a hands-on environment.
